name: MoYu WeiPo WR M
description: The WeiPo WR M is MoYu’s first magnetic 2x2. This 2x2 features a new lightweight design to improve performance. There are slots fitted with medium/strong magnets to make this puzzle more stable, and an upgraded mechanism to make sure you never miss a turn! Also, the stickerless bright version features an updated color scheme to improve contrast and make recognition easier.
